jcr:title: FlowTriever Retrieval/Aspiration System
jcr:description: The FlowTriever system is a lytic-free approach for the treatment of pulmonary embolism through both large bore aspiration and mechanical thrombectomy.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
FlowTriever® Retrieval/Aspiration System

Purpose-driven innovation. Proven clinical performance.

Designed for the single-session, lytic-free treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE).

text_copy.text:
Purpose-built for the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE)

The FlowTriever system offers patients suffering from acute PE immediate symptom relief and reversal of right heart strain that can lead to mortality and long-term morbidity.1

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Triever Aspiration Catheters

text.text:
The Triever catheters deliver large-bore aspiration for rapid clot removal and immediate symptom improvement.

The Triever16®, Triever20® and Triever24® catheters are highly trackable to navigate tortuous anatomy.
The Triever16 Curve catheter is the latest innovation in venous thrombus removal, providing excellent torque response for multidirectional aspiration and maximum clot removal.

text_copy.text: The Triever20 Curve is a steerable large-bore catheter with customizable directionality for improved engagement and extraction of venous clot.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: A) 225° directionality for improved navigation

text.text: The FlowTriever catheter has nitinol disks that conform to the unique anatomy of pulmonary vasculature for the disruption and removal of clot.

text_626397786.text: The FlowTriever2 catheter features a laser cut element with open cell design to facilitate clot removal with the FlowTriever system.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: FlowSaver Blood Return System

text_607788374.text: The FlowSaver system is designed to reduce blood loss by filtering aspirated thrombi for blood reinfusion back to the patient.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: A) 40-micron filter to return aspirated blood with negligible hemolysis*

text.text: * <0.1% increase in hemolysis. Data on File.

text_copy.text: The Intri24 sheath has a 24 Fr design compatible with the Triever20 and Triever24 catheters.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
A) 33cm hydrophilic coated shaft with radiopaque marker band

B) Single-hand hemostasis valve operation

Indications For Use

The FlowTriever Retrieval/Aspiration System is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The FlowTriever Retrieval/Aspiration System is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever Catheters are indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The Triever Catheters are intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever Catheters are also intended for use in treating clot in transit in the right atrium, but not in conjunction with the FlowTriever Catheters. The FlowTriever2 Catheter is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from peripheral blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The FlowTriever2 Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE). The Triever20 Curve Catheter is used coaxially within the Triever24 Catheter for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/ or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The Triever20 Curve Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever20 Curve Catheter is not indicated for use with the FlowTriever Catheters. The Triever20 Curve Catheter is also intended for use in treating clot in transit in the right atrium, but not in conjunction with the FlowTriever Catheters. The Triever20 Curve Catheter must be used within the Triever24 Catheter. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is indicated for (1) The non-surgical removal of emboli and thrombi from blood vessels. (2) Injection, infusion, and/or aspiration of contrast media and other ﬂuids into or from a blood vessel. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is intended for use in the peripheral vasculature and for the treatment of pulmonary embolism. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is not indicated for use with the FlowTriever Catheters. The Triever16 Curve Catheter is also intended for use in treating clot in transit in the right atrium but not in conjunction with the FlowTriever Catheters. The FlowSaver Blood Return System is used with Inari Medical catheters and sheaths for autologous blood transfusion.

Review complete Instructions for Use, Indications for Use, Warnings, Precautions, Possible Adverse Effects and Contraindications prior to use of the product. 

Caution: Federal (USA) law restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician.
